findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子自述：公司在部分國防產品的市占提升，使部分對手處於不利份額位置；對手可能反應，客戶也可能擔憂供應商集中。
findings.excerpt: In addition, our increased market share has caused an adverse share position for some of our competitors for these products. Competitor response to our market penetration is possible. Our customers may also raise concerns about their supplier concentration issues and the risk exposure related to this concentration.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司在所有市場面臨競爭，部分對手資源更大或因地理／匯率具成本優勢，可能因低成本對手而失去份額、價格轉變。
findings.excerpt: Certain competitors may also have a cost advantage compared to us due to their geography or changes in relative currency values and may compete against us based on price.

findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要對手：國防含 DC Fabricators、PCC、Triumph Aerospace、Xylem；能源與製程含 Croll Reynolds、Gardner Denver、GEA Wiegand 等；未見搜尋到具名新進入者。
